provenance.note: Re-recording is its own change, carrying the normalization change that caused it.

payload.text: Building the part first so the edge exists to fillet.
The tread face is tagged, so the edge is addressable.

arguments.question: Which edge should the fillet follow?

options.label: Top outer edge
options.consequence: Softens the visible rim; adds 0.4 g.

payload.question: Keep the 2 mm fillet or widen it?

options.label: Keep 2 mm
options.consequence: No mass change; matches the drawing.

options.label: Widen to 3 mm
options.consequence: Removes 0.6 g and softens the rim.
